description: Unit test class for DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter, testing logging behaviors with mock objects, MDC handling, and various logging levels.

classes.name: DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapterTest
classes.description: Test suite for DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter, verifying correct behavior of logging, MDC handling, and error conditions.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Tests that passing null logger to the factory method throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullLoggerName
methods.description: Tests that null loggerName causes NullPointerException.

methods.name: getInstanceWithBlankLoggerName
methods.description: Checks that empty string as loggerName throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: getNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getName() returns the correct logger name.

methods.name: withCorrelationIdLogInfo
methods.description: Tests logging info messages with a correlation ID set in MDC.

methods.name: withMdcEntryLogDebug
methods.description: Tests MDC entries and debug log call.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntryPairsLogDebug
methods.description: Checks multiple MDC entries and debug logging.

methods.name: withThreeMdcEntryPairsLogDebug
methods.description: Verifies handling of three MDC entries and debug logs.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntriesLogWarning
methods.description: Tests MDC entries with warning level logging.

methods.name: putNothingToMdcAndDoNotLogAsInfoIsDisabled
methods.description: Ensures no logging occurs when info level is disabled.

methods.name: logDebugAndWarnWithTwoMdcValuesThenDiscardMdcEntries
methods.description: Tests logging debug and warning messages with MDC entries and discarding them.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaKey
methods.description: Removes MDC entry using key and verifies log outputs.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaNullValue
methods.description: Removes MDC entry by setting its value to null and verifies behavior.

methods.name: setCorrelationIdLogErrorDoNotDiscard
methods.description: Checks setting correlation ID and logging error without clearing MDC.

methods.name: setCorrelationIdLogErrorDoNotClose
methods.description: Similar to above, emphasizing logging at error level.

methods.name: setCorrelationIdLogInfoThenDiscardCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests setting correlation ID, logging info, then discarding it.

methods.name: logMoreThan4LoggingArgsError
methods.description: Verifies formatting and logging of error messages with more than four arguments.

methods.name: logMoreThan4LoggingArgsWarning
methods.description: Verifies formatting and logging of warning messages with multiple args.

methods.name: logMoreThan4LoggingArgsInfo
methods.description: Tests info-level logging with multiple arguments.

methods.name: logMoreThan4LoggingArgsDebug
methods.description: Tests debug-level logging with multiple arguments.
